Playbook.name: NETSCOUT AED — Surge in High-Confidence Threat Activity Against a Bank - SOC Playbook

ExecutiveSummary.Overview: NETSCOUT AED reported a surge of high-confidence threat activity (Botnet C2, ATLAS threat categories, blocked hosts) against the bank. Triage: real botnet/C2/threat activity involving bank IPs, or benign traffic mis-categorised?
ExecutiveSummary.BusinessImpact: High-confidence AED threat activity (botnet C2, known-bad hosts) indicates compromised hosts or targeted attack infrastructure.

Assets.AssetType: Bank internet-facing services behind NETSCOUT AED (DDoS protection)

TelemetryRequirements.Requirement: NETSCOUT Arbor Edge Defense CEF (verified live). Fields: source.ip, source.geo, source.as.organization.name, destination.ip, cef.extensions.deviceCustomString2 (protection group / bank service), cef.device.event_class_id (attack type), cef.extensions.deviceCustomString6 (threat category), cef.severity.

InitialAssessment.Rule: Weigh the full evidence story per the ClassificationGuidance, not any single fact.

Investigation.Goal: Determine whether the threat surge reflects real botnet/C2 activity involving bank assets or benign mis-categorisation.

Step.name: Threat categories and involved bank IPs
Step.Purpose: The threat categories and whether bank IPs are the source or destination show compromise vs inbound attack.
Step.Query: FROM logs-cef.log-* | WHERE observer.vendor == "NETSCOUT" AND (cef.extensions.deviceCustomString6 RLIKE "(?i).*(botnet|command and control|malware|atlas).*" OR cef.device.event_class_id RLIKE "(?i).*(botnet|threat|denied).*") AND @timestamp >= NOW() - 4 hours | STATS events = COUNT(*), categories = VALUES(cef.extensions.deviceCustomString6), classes = VALUES(cef.device.event_class_id), int_ips = VALUES(destination.ip) | LIMIT 1
Step.AnalystNotes: Botnet C2 with a BANK internal IP as source = a compromised internal host beaconing (high priority - pivot to endpoint IR). Bank IP as destination = inbound threat traffic (perimeter). Read the categories.

Step.name: Involved sources/destinations
Step.Purpose: Identify the internal (bank) IPs involved so compromised hosts can be triaged.
Step.Query: FROM logs-cef.log-* | WHERE observer.vendor == "NETSCOUT" AND cef.extensions.deviceCustomString6 RLIKE "(?i).*(botnet|command|malware).*" AND @timestamp >= NOW() - 4 hours | STATS events = COUNT(*), threat_cats = VALUES(cef.extensions.deviceCustomString6) BY source.ip, destination.ip | SORT events DESC | LIMIT 15
Step.AnalystNotes: Any bank-range IP (per the AED protection group / AS 'Jordan Commercial Bank') appearing as a botnet C2 source is a compromised host - escalate to endpoint IR.

Node.Condition: A bank internal IP flagged as a botnet/C2 source (compromised internal host).
Node.Result: True Positive (Compromised Host / C2 - endpoint IR)

Node.Condition: Inbound high-confidence threat traffic to bank IPs, blocked by AED.
A benign service mis-categorised as a threat.
Threat surge with unclear entity involvement.

DocumentationChecklist.Item: Attach outputs of INV-01-NS-THREATS, INV-02-NS-ENTITIES to the case.

SOCAction.Item: Confirm benign; tune AED category; close.

TruePositive.Definition: Real botnet/C2 threat activity involving bank assets.

SOCAction.Item: If internal-source: endpoint IR on that host. If inbound: confirm AED blocking, monitor. Correlate with endpoint/FortiGate telemetry.

Indicators.Item: Benign traffic in a threat category.

Phase.name: Immediate Actions (0-30 minutes)
Phase.Action: Identify involved bank IPs; if an internal IP is a C2 source, escalate to endpoint IR.
Confirm AED blocking for inbound threats.

Phase.name: Containment and Eradication (hours)
Phase.Action: Endpoint IR on compromised internal hosts; correlate with endpoint/firewall telemetry.

Phase.name: Recovery and Hardening (days)
Phase.Action: Tune AED threat categories; integrate AED threat IPs into blocklists and endpoint hunting.

QualityChecks.Check: deviceCustomString6 = threat category; bank AS is 'Jordan Commercial Bank'. Correlate internal C2 sources with endpoint telemetry.

TruePositiveClosure.Item: Compromised host(s) IR'd; threat IPs blocked; correlated.
